purpose: Teach: ジャングル/大谷/月日/レンタカー/横須賀/姓/細工/繁華

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ジャングルクルーズの動画、見たことある?私、最近、よく、見てるんだよ、本当に、面白いの、リクも、見てみてね、絶対。
lines.en: Riku, have you seen those Jungle Cruise videos? I've been watching them constantly lately—they're so funny. You have to check them out, seriously.
lines.style: Bright, rapid-fire delivery. Genuine enthusiasm without performing it. Leans forward slightly. Energy that invites him in rather than demands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。大谷選手のサイン、お父さん、欲しがってるんだぜ、桜、お前、ファンだろ、本当に、すごい選手だよな、世界、本当に、活躍。
lines.en: Yeah. Shohei Ohtani's autograph, actually—my dad's been wanting one. You're a fan too, right? He's an incredible player. The way he performs on the world stage is just…
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Starts confident, then softens into something more genuine mid-thought. Slight pause before trailing into admiration. Not showing off—just sharing something real.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リクと、知り合ってから、もう、結構、月日、経ったよね、本当に、長い付き合いだよね、私、嬉しいよ、ずっと、お友達、続いていて。
lines.en: You know, it's been a while since we met. Time's really gone by. We've built something pretty long-lasting here, haven't we? I'm really happy we've kept this friendship going.
lines.style: Slower pace, genuine warmth underneath. Hesitant—like she's admitting something she usually keeps quiet. Soft, steady eye contact level. Trailing off with quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、家族で、レンタカー、借りて、旅行に行くって、お父さん、計画してくれてるよ、桜、お前のところも、家族旅行?
lines.en: My family's planning to rent a car for a summer road trip. Dad's got the whole thing figured out. Are you guys doing a family trip too?
lines.style: Curious but easy. Leaning back slightly, genuinely interested in his answer. Natural conversational beat—not pushing, just asking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 横須賀の、いとこ、夏に、遊びに来るって、聞いたよ、リク、紹介できるかな、絶対、仲良くなれそうだよね、本当に、楽しみ。
lines.en: Oh, my cousin from Yokosuka is coming to visit this summer. I was thinking—could I introduce you two? I really think you'd get along. I'm so excited about it.
lines.style: Warm and bright. Picks up pace with genuine optimism. Opening attack is immediate and natural. Voice has the quality of imagining something good happening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の姓、結構、珍しいんだよな、桜、由来とか、聞いたこと、あるか?俺、ちょっと、興味、ある、本当に、面白い、家系図、ありそうだよな。
lines.en: Actually, my last name is pretty unusual. Have you ever wondered about the origin? I've been curious about it myself—there's probably some interesting family history buried in there somewhere.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower. Testing the waters with vulnerability. A subtle shift from her usual surface persona. Genuine curiosity peeking through, not guarded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 美術部、細工の作品、文化祭、出すんだよ、リク、見にきてね、本当に、頑張ってるんだよ、私、絶対、感動するから、ね、楽しみ、本当に。
lines.en: Our art club's submitting a woodcarving piece for the school festival. You have to come see it, okay? I've been working really hard on it. I promise you'll be moved. I'm looking forward to showing you.
lines.style: Warm but with an undercurrent of genuine pride. Emphasis on the personal ask—'you have to come.' Slight vulnerability in admitting the work matters to her. Ends on quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 放課後、繁華街、皆で、行こうぜ、桜、新しいお店、行ってみたいんだ、お前も、付き合ってくれる?本当に、楽しみだよな、絶対。
lines.en: Hey, want to hit up the downtown area with everyone after school? There's a new shop I've been wanting to try. Would you come with me? It'd be a lot of fun.
lines.style: Light, inviting energy. Testing the ground—casual enough that he can easily say yes, but with a warmth that suggests it matters she's asking him. Quick pace, natural friendliness.
